name: @egen/esm-tenant
description: Tenant capture system for EGEN SPA — resolves the active tenant from the URL (subdomain/path/query/JWT) and exposes it globally (store + window). No local tenant registry, no frontend validation — see src/types.ts.

scripts.build: rimraf dist && concurrently "swc --strip-leading-paths src -d dist" "tsc --project tsconfig.build.json"
scripts.build:development: rimraf dist && concurrently "swc --strip-leading-paths src -d dist" "tsc --project tsconfig.build.json"
